mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_scope ( id, coupon_template_id, scope_target_type, category_id, spu_id, sku_id ) SELECT decode(raw.id_hex, 'hex'), decode(raw.coupon_template_id_hex, 'hex'), raw.scope_target_type, raw.category_id, raw.spu_id, CASE WHEN raw.sku_id_hex IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE decode(raw.sku_id_hex, 'hex') END FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( id_hex text, coupon_template_id_hex text, scope_target_type text, category_id bigint, spu_id bigint, sku_id_hex text )

choose.when: WITH incoming AS ( SELECT DISTINCT raw.target_id AS target_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw(target_id bigint) ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_category c INNER JOIN incoming i ON i.target_id = c.id

WITH incoming AS ( SELECT DISTINCT raw.target_id AS target_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw(target_id bigint) ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_spu p INNER JOIN incoming i ON i.target_id = p.id
choose.otherwise: WITH incoming AS ( SELECT DISTINCT decode(raw.target_id_hex, 'hex') AS target_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw(target_id_hex text) ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN incoming i ON i.target_id = s.id

mapper.select: SELECT encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", scope_target_type AS "scopeTargetType", category_id AS "categoryId", spu_id AS "spuId", encode(sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId" FROM coupon_scope WHERE coupon_template_id = #{couponTemplateId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
